statement: Replacing half of an old mouse's plasma with saline and albumin rejuvenated muscle, liver and brain measures as much as, or more than, exchange with young blood — indicating dilution of old factors rather than transfer of young ones.

context.intervention: neutral blood exchange (plasma replaced with saline-albumin)

measurement.assay: muscle repair, liver adiposity and fibrosis, neurogenesis
measurement.effect: equal or greater rejuvenation with neutral exchange

replication.note: One group (Conboy), reinterpreting their own earlier parabiosis work.

limitations: measures are tissue markers rather than function over time

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
